note: Verified donation channels for Assam flood relief. Every entry links to the organisation's own official page — this app does not collect or route money. Check each site once before donating and confirm the account matches what is published there.

channels.name: Chief Minister's Relief Fund, Assam
channels.summary: Official state government relief fund. Money is spent by the CM's office for flood relief and rehabilitation. Contributions are 80G tax exempt.

account.name: Chief Minister's Relief Fund Assam
account.bank: State Bank of India, Secretariat Branch

channels.name: PM CARES Fund
channels.organization: Prime Minister's Office, Government of India
channels.summary: National emergency and disaster relief fund. Accepts domestic and foreign donations. Contributions are 80G tax exempt.

account.name: PM CARES
account.bank: State Bank of India, New Delhi Main Branch

channels.name: Goonj — Rahat Floods
channels.summary: Long-running NGO delivering essential relief material to families in Assam and other flood-hit states.

channels.name: SEEDS India — Flood Response
channels.summary: Emergency response teams distributing family kits, hygiene kits, and transitional shelters in Assam districts including Jorhat and Cachar.

channels.name: Rapid Response — Assam Floods
channels.summary: Disaster relief NGO working in Assam since 2016; provides food packets, dry ration, hygiene kits and medical camps.

channels.name: Assam Foundation of North America — Flood Relief 2026
channels.summary: Volunteer-run foundation channeling international donations through FCRA-registered partners for groceries, medical, and emergency supplies in Upper Assam.

inKindNote: Donating supplies (dry ration, hygiene kits, tarpaulin, etc.) is coordinated by ASDMA. Call the toll-free line 1077 or email sdma-assam@assam.gov.in before sending anything — unsolicited perishables slow down relief.
